---
title: "Build: methods and assessments"
description: "Method development, data-scarce assessments, data harmonisation, analysis and decision support, delivered with uncertainty."
---

For questions that off-the-shelf methods don't answer, or places where the usual data doesn't exist. Every result comes with its uncertainty, so you know how far it can be trusted.

::: {.cards}

::: {.card-item}
### Method development
Designing, validating and documenting a method for a problem without an established solution.
:::

::: {.card-item}
### Assessments in data-scarce settings
Soil and landscape maps, hydrologic soil groups, curve number and retention surfaces for hydrological models, soil-water flux, and carbon stocks.
:::

::: {.card-item}
### Updating and harmonising data
Bringing legacy surveys, mixed depths and mixed methods into one consistent dataset. Maps are updated, not started again.
:::

::: {.card-item}
### Geostatistics and analysis
Kriging, mixed models, model validation, and fixing problem datasets.
:::

::: {.card-item}
### Decision support
Combining sources of uncertainty into decision maps, prioritising areas, and plain-language summaries for the people who have to act.
:::

::: {.card-item}
### Advanced versions of our tools
Continuous rather than discrete calculations, uncertainty propagation, and custom builds of the free tools.
:::

:::

Methods are interpretable "glass-box" functions benchmarked against machine-learning alternatives, so every result can be traced and checked. Clients receive a licence to use the methods and results built for them. RafikiArdhi keeps the methods themselves and may later release an open version.

Engineering work that requires a licensed professional engineer is carried out alongside that engineer.
